questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Level high similar to KU Denmark, but how the courses are conducted is quite different. In Finland a lot of courses rely in the exercise classes for people to present(picked at random) if you go to exercise class you get max points. I dont find this way pretty usefull, i prefer handing in a document which is graded by a TA or Professor who knows what they are doing. Furthermore are most grades here an evalutaion of exercise points and the exam.
